title: AutoEnvScaling: Automating the Data Flywheel with Terminal Agents
abstract: Terminal agents solve tasks in software engineering and scientific research by executing commands in a terminal. Training them via reinforcement learning (RL) requires diverse and verifiable environments, but these environments are still mostly designed by human researchers, so their supply grows only as fast as researchers can work. We introduce AutoEnvScaling, which treats environment design as a terminal task and uses agents to automate the data flywheel. A proposer agent builds new RL environments from the rollouts of the solver being trained, and the solver's new rollouts guide the next round. By turning environment generation into a terminal task, AutoEnvScaling increases the valid-environment rate by up to 25 times compared to prompt-only generation, at up to 75% lower cost per valid environment. We show that training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on AutoEnvScaling environments from GPT-5.6-sol improves its Terminal-Bench 2.1 score by 4.3 points over the matched Tmax baseline. The broader goal of AutoEnvScaling is to enable recursive self-improvement (RSI): by making both environment generation and solving terminal tasks, it lets one model co-evolve in both roles. We show that Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, acting in both roles, gains 12.2 points on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and raises its Terminal-Bench 4.0 score from 1.6 to 3.2. The pipeline also generalizes across agentic domains, generating environments for software engineering, computer use, professional work, and GPU kernel programming. Overall, these results show a path toward agents building their own training environments, reducing human reliance and taking a core step toward RSI.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Imagine a graduate seminar called Deep Reinforcement Learning Methods. Today's lecture is on Auto Env Scaling: Automating the Data Flywheel with Terminal Agents. Recent work such as Agent-World and Self-Harness reflects a shift toward agents that build environments or improve their own tools. This paper asks whether environment design itself can join the training loop. Researchers from Microsoft, Northeastern, Stanford, and other universities explore that idea. Noah, I see your hand; go ahead.
segments.zh: 想象有一门研究生讨论课，叫深度强化学习方法。今天的课讲的是自动环境扩展：用终端智能体实现数据飞轮自动化。最近的Agent-World和Self-Harness这类工作，反映出一种趋势，就是让智能体去搭建环境，或者改进自己的工具。这篇论文要问的是，环境设计本身能不能也进入训练循环。来自微软、东北大学、斯坦福等高校的研究者探讨了这个想法。Noah，我看到你举手了，请讲。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, what exactly is the bottleneck this paper is trying to remove?
segments.zh: 教授您好，这篇论文想消除的瓶颈到底是什么？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The bottleneck is the supply of useful, executable tasks. A terminal agent needs more than a written prompt: it needs a working setup, a way to verify success, and a difficulty level that teaches rather than overwhelms. People typically have to design, implement, debug, and revise those pieces. Auto Env Scaling gives a proposer agent a terminal sandbox and asks it to do that work, guided by evidence about what the solver can and cannot do.
segments.zh: 瓶颈在于有用且可执行的任务供给不足。一个终端智能体需要的不仅仅是一段写好的提示词：它需要一个能跑起来的环境、一种验证成功的方式，以及一个既能教学又不会压垮它的难度水平。这些东西通常都得靠人来设计、实现、调试和修改。Auto Env Scaling 给提议者智能体一个终端沙盒，让它来完成这些工作，并以求解器能做什么、不能做什么作为依据来指导。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The central contribution is an iterative data flywheel. A solver attempts tasks, and its successes and failures become evidence for what to generate next. A proposer builds a complete task package: instructions, an execution environment, a reference solution, and tests. The solver sees the instructions and task container, but not the reference solution or tests. That separation is meant to make success depend on actually completing the task.
segments.zh: 核心贡献是一个迭代式的数据飞轮。求解器尝试任务，它的成功和失败会成为下一步生成什么的依据。提议器构建一个完整的任务包：指令、执行环境、参考解和测试。求解器只能看到指令和任务容器，看不到参考解和测试。这种隔离是为了让成功真正取决于是否完成了任务。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So the proposer is not just writing task descriptions; it is building runnable environments?
segments.zh: 所以提出者不只是写任务描述，而是在构建可运行的环境？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. The proposer works in a separate sandbox with coding tools, child containers for building and testing, and restricted web access. Its workspace can include past environments, solver rollouts, verifier results, and retained tools or memory. A generation assignment identifies a parent task and reports the solver's pass rate and common failure. The proposer can respond with a simpler variant or a harder one, and can test a candidate against the solver.
segments.zh: 没错。提议器在一个独立的沙盒里工作，配有编程工具、用于构建和测试的子容器，以及受限的网络访问。它的工作区可以包含过往环境、求解器轨迹、验证器结果，以及保留的工具或记忆。一个生成任务会指定一个父任务，并报告求解器的通过率和常见失败模式。提议器可以据此给出更简单的变体或更难的变体，还能拿候选任务去测试求解器。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The second key idea is to validate and calibrate tasks before using them for training. A task must build, the reference solution must earn full reward, and an empty solution must earn less than half. The system also checks for exact 13-gram overlap with held-out benchmark instructions. Then it targets a mean solver reward between 0.25 and 0.75, with variation across attempts, and revises or removes tasks outside that range.
segments.zh: 第二个关键想法是，在把任务用于训练之前，先对它们做验证和校准。一个任务必须能构建成功，参考答案必须拿到满分奖励，而空答案拿到的奖励必须低于一半。系统还会检查它与留出的基准指令之间是否存在精确的13-gram重叠。然后，它会把求解器的平均奖励目标定在0.25到0.75之间，并让不同尝试之间有变化，超出这个范围的任务会被修改或移除。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: does passing those checks guarantee that the tests measure the intended behavior?
segments.zh: 快速问一下：通过那些检查就能保证测试衡量的是预期行为吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: No. The checks establish basic executability and catch some weak or contaminated tasks, but they cannot guarantee that the tests are correct. A reference solution and its tests might share the same flaw, and an exact text-overlap check will miss paraphrased contamination. That is why the paper also uses Harbor's task-review process. The broader point is that automated admission can reduce routine screening, but it does not replace independent scrutiny of task quality.
segments.zh: 不能。这些检查只能确认基本可执行性，并抓出一些薄弱或受污染的任务，但无法保证测试本身是正确的。参考解和它的测试可能共享同一个缺陷，而精确文本重叠检查会漏掉改述式的污染。正因如此，论文还采用了 Harbor 的任务审查流程。更广泛地说，自动化准入可以减少常规筛查，但它不能替代对任务质量的独立审查。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The third enabling insight is that feedback changes both task selection and training. The solver receives partial credit based on the fraction of tests passed. The proposer receives negative reward for failed validation or failed calibration, and positive reward when both succeed. In shared-model experiments, proposer and solver rewards are handled separately during training. The solver updates at each step, while the proposer generates new environments at intervals.
segments.zh: 第三个关键洞见是，反馈会同时改变任务选择和训练过程。求解器会根据通过的测试比例获得部分分数。提议者在验证失败或校准失败时会收到负奖励，两者都成功时则获得正奖励。在共享模型的实验中，提议者和求解器的奖励在训练期间是分开处理的。求解器每一步都会更新，而提议者则按一定间隔生成新环境。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How much difference does solver feedback make compared with simply generating a fixed pool?
segments.zh: 与单纯生成一个固定池相比，求解器反馈带来的差异有多大？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In matched comparisons, the evolving curriculum improves held-out Terminal-Bench 2.1 results over static Tmax pools made by the same proposer. For Qwen three point five, nine B, one comparison rises from 27.2 to 33.5, and another from 29.2 to 36.6. Removing solver trajectories from the proposer's workspace reduces performance. That ablation supports the value of feedback, though it does not isolate every possible difference in task composition.
segments.zh: 在匹配对比中，演化式课程在留出的Terminal-Bench 2.1结果上优于同一提议者生成的静态Tmax池。对Qwen 3.5 9B来说，一组对比从27.2升到33.5，另一组从29.2升到36.6。从提议者的工作区中移除求解器轨迹会降低性能。这一消融实验支持了反馈的价值，尽管它并未隔离任务构成中所有可能的差异。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The paper also measures whether the terminal workflow produces usable environments more efficiently. Across 8 proposer models, validity exceeds prompt-only generation and prompt generation with execution feedback. For DeepSeek V4 Flash, validity rises from 3.5% with prompting to 89% with Auto Env Scaling. Cost per valid environment falls for 6 of 8 models, by as much as 75%. The generated tasks average 47.2 solver turns, compared with 33.8 for prompt-plus-feedback tasks.
segments.zh: 论文还衡量了终端工作流是否能更高效地生成可用环境。在8个提议者模型上，其有效性都超过了仅靠提示词生成以及带执行反馈的提示词生成。对DeepSeek V4 Flash来说，有效性从仅用提示词的3.5%提升到使用自动环境扩展后的89%。8个模型中有6个的每个有效环境成本下降，降幅最高达75%。生成的任务平均需要47.2个求解器轮次，而提示词加反馈任务为33.8个轮次。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Could longer tasks and lower pass rates alone tell us that the generated curriculum is better?
segments.zh: 更长的任务和更低的通过率本身就能说明生成的课程更好吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: No; those measurements describe task scale and difficulty, not quality by themselves. The stronger evidence comes from downstream training comparisons. In shared-model experiments, Qwen three point six, 35 B A3B, first receives 600 proposer trajectories, raising acceptance from 32.3% to 86.8%. It then serves as proposer and solver. Terminal-Bench 2.1 rises from 41.1 to 53.3, while a static comparison trails by 6.1 points.
segments.zh: 不能；这些指标只描述了任务规模和难度，本身并不代表质量。更有力的证据来自下游训练对比。在共享模型实验中，Qwen 3.6 35B A3B 首先接收600条提议者轨迹，将接受率从32.3%提升到86.8%。随后它同时充当提议者和求解者。Terminal-Bench 2.1 从41.1提升到53.3，而静态对比则落后6.1分。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The implications are promising but bounded. The shared model also improves on Terminal-Bench 4.0, from 1.6 to 3.2, and the paper reports gains on HiL-Bench software-engineering tasks. Yet proposer-side training matters: without those updates, validity declines and training collapses in the reported ablation. The authors also report accepted environments across 7 domains, including browser use and GPU kernels, but those results establish technical admission, not learning gains in those settings.
segments.zh: 这些发现前景可观，但也有其局限。共享模型在Terminal-Bench 4.0上同样有所提升，从1.6提高到3.2，论文还报告了在HiL-Bench软件工程任务上的增益。但proposer侧的训练很关键：根据论文中的消融实验，如果不做这些更新，有效性会下降，训练会崩溃。作者还报告了在7个领域中被接受的环境，包括浏览器使用和GPU内核，但这些结果只证明了技术上的准入，并不代表在这些场景中获得了学习上的提升。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How does this fit with work like Agent-World, and what should we be cautious about when thinking of recursive improvement?
segments.zh: 这和Agent-World这类工作有什么关系？在思考递归式改进时，我们又该警惕什么？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Agent-World also emphasizes executable environments and verifiable tasks, while Self-Harness focuses on improving the agent's tools and runtime through bounded edits. Auto Env Scaling brings task generation into the solver's feedback loop, and tests a shared proposer-solver model. But the recursive-improvement claim remains an initial demonstration: experiments cover finite runs, Terminal-Bench 4.0 scores remain low, and comparisons match training steps rather than total compute or elapsed time. Sustained improvement is still an open question.
segments.zh: Agent-World 同样强调可执行环境和可验证任务，而 Self-Harness 侧重通过有边界的修改来改进智能体的工具和运行时。Auto Env Scaling 把任务生成带进了求解器的反馈回路，并测试了一种共享的提议者-求解器模型。但递归自我改进这个说法目前还只是初步验证：实验只覆盖了有限轮次，Terminal-Bench 4.0 的分数仍然很低，而且对比是按训练步数来匹配的，不是按总计算量或实际耗时。能不能持续改进，仍然是个悬而未决的问题。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The useful takeaway is that environment generation can be treated as part of agent training: build a task, check it, calibrate it against the current solver, and use the resulting attempts to guide the next round. That creates a practical route to refreshing training data, not a guarantee of endless self-improvement. Independent verification, compute-aware evaluations, and tests across more domains will determine how broadly the approach holds. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 真正有用的结论是，环境生成可以当作智能体训练的一部分：构建任务、检查任务、根据当前求解器校准任务，再用产生的尝试来指导下一轮。这为刷新训练数据提供了一条切实可行的路径，但并不保证能实现无止境的自我改进。独立验证、考虑算力的评估，以及在更多领域中的测试，将决定这种方法到底有多大的普适性。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的AI助手，或者留言评论。
